transcript.en_text: And that's something to be proud of.
transcript.zh_text: 这是值得骄傲的事。

transcript.en_text: And since then, this school and its students have flourished.
transcript.zh_text: 从那以后，这所学校和它的学生们蓬勃发展。

transcript.en_text: A young, eager community of men and women of all races and backgrounds, a true reflection of America's future.
transcript.zh_text: 一个年轻、朝气蓬勃的男女学生群体，各族裔各背景兼有，是美国未来的真实写照。

transcript.en_text: How did he convince you to come back?
transcript.zh_text: 他怎么说服你回来的？

transcript.en_text: I convinced myself.
transcript.zh_text: 是我自己说服自己的。

transcript.en_text: Forty-six years I was married to my husband before he passed.
transcript.zh_text: 我和我丈夫结婚了四十六年，直到他去世。

transcript.en_text: But if he'd pulled on me what Frank pulled on you, he would've been long gone.
transcript.zh_text: 但如果他对我做了弗兰克对你做的事，他早就被赶走了。

transcript.en_text: I think it's worked out for the best.
transcript.zh_text: 我觉得结果还是好的。

transcript.en_text: Your daughter is going to make a fabulous congresswoman.
transcript.zh_text: 你女儿会成为一位出色的女议员。

transcript.en_text: Well, thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，谢谢。

transcript.en_text: Two minutes.
transcript.zh_text: 还有两分钟。

transcript.en_text: Now, Frank Underwood understands the need for equality, in education and throughout our lives.
transcript.zh_text: 弗兰克·安德伍德理解在教育和生活各方面实现平等的必要性。

transcript.en_text: Most of all, he believes in giving every American the opportunity to earn a living.
transcript.zh_text: 最重要的是，他相信要给每个美国人谋生的机会。

transcript.en_text: He put this belief into action before and he will again, and Frank Underwood will not allow this journey to end with Limestone.
transcript.zh_text: 他之前就把这个信念付诸了行动，他还会再做一次，弗兰克·安德伍德不会让这段旅程止步于石灰石学院。

transcript.en_text: You will go out into this world and astonish us all with your intellect, your... your worthiness, and your strength.
transcript.zh_text: 你们将走向这个世界，用你们的才智、你们的价值和你们的力量让我们惊叹。

transcript.en_text: Now, I would like to introduce two of the strongest women I know.
transcript.zh_text: 现在，我想介绍两位我认识的最坚强的女性。

transcript.en_text: Well, don't you look thick as thieves.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，你们看起来亲密得很。

transcript.en_text: ...and the First Lady of the United States, Claire Underwood.
transcript.zh_text: ……以及美利坚合众国第一夫人，克莱尔·安德伍德。

transcript.en_text: It's as though she never left.
transcript.zh_text: 她就好像从来没有离开过。

transcript.en_text: And that's what I'm afraid of.
transcript.zh_text: 这正是我担心的。

transcript.en_text: All right, let's hurry on up, now.
transcript.zh_text: 好了，我们快点。

transcript.en_text: Bugayev is telling me that they are willing to reduce their oil output by another 20% by the first of next month.
transcript.zh_text: 布加耶夫告诉我他们愿意在下个月初再削减20%的石油产量。

transcript.en_text: What are the projections on gas prices?
transcript.zh_text: 油价预测是多少？

transcript.en_text: North of 150 a barrel for oil.
transcript.zh_text: 油价在每桶150美元以上。

transcript.en_text: Six, maybe $7 a gallon for fuel.
transcript.zh_text: 燃油每加仑六到七美元。

transcript.en_text: My phone has been ringing off the hook, sir, from the U.K. to Poland.
transcript.zh_text: 我的电话响个不停，先生，从英国到波兰都在打来。

transcript.en_text: The IMF wants to help us with the debt relief solution.
transcript.zh_text: 国际货币基金组织想帮我们制定债务减免方案。

transcript.en_text: Sir?
transcript.zh_text: 先生？

transcript.en_text: We need to respond to strength with strength.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要以强硬对强硬。

transcript.en_text: Well, I don't know how we could be any stronger, other than to invade Russia.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，除了入侵俄罗斯，我不知道我们还能有多强硬。

transcript.en_text: And what if we do?
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们真这么做呢？

transcript.en_text: - Excuse me, sir? - Not with troops.
transcript.zh_text: ——先生，您说什么？——不是派军队。

transcript.en_text: With fear.
transcript.zh_text: 用恐惧。

transcript.en_text: He's never trusted us.
transcript.zh_text: 他从来不信任我们。

transcript.en_text: He already thinks we're behind Milkin's failed coup.
transcript.zh_text: 他已经认为我们是米尔金政变未遂的幕后黑手。

transcript.en_text: What if we put Milkin in a position to succeed.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们让米尔金处于能够成功的位置呢。

transcript.en_text: Now, I don't care if Milkin actually succeeds.
transcript.zh_text: 我不在乎米尔金是否真的成功。

transcript.en_text: Unfreeze all his assets. Fly him to a border country.
transcript.zh_text: 解冻他所有的资产。把他飞到一个边境国家。

transcript.en_text: Put him in a room with other dissidents.
transcript.zh_text: 把他和其他持不同政见者放在一个房间里。

transcript.en_text: Petrov needs to know that we'll stop at nothing.
transcript.zh_text: 彼得罗夫需要知道我们会不择手段。

transcript.en_text: Sir, the diplomatic repercussions of such an action-- All I want is the appearance.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，这种行动的外交后果—— 我要的只是表象。

transcript.en_text: Let's look at best and worst case scenarios as soon as possible.
transcript.zh_text: 让我们尽快看一下最好和最坏情况的分析。

transcript.en_text: Thank you very much.
transcript.zh_text: 非常感谢。

transcript.en_text: Oh, I'm sorry. I thought you were-- That bed was too stiff.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，对不起。我以为你是—— 那张床太硬了。

transcript.en_text: - I'll sleep in there then. - Sleep in here.
transcript.zh_text: ——那我睡那边。——睡这里吧。

transcript.en_text: We had the mattress on the floor.
transcript.zh_text: 我们以前把床垫铺在地上。

transcript.en_text: What?
transcript.zh_text: 什么？

transcript.en_text: That first year, the mattress and those lumpy pillows.
transcript.zh_text: 第一年，床垫和那些坑坑洼洼的枕头。

highlights.zh_word: 坑坑洼洼的/疙疙瘩瘩的

transcript.en_text: Which you used to steal from me in the middle of the night.
transcript.zh_text: 你总是半夜从我这偷走枕头。

transcript.en_text: Well, because you would hog all the covers.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，因为你会霸占所有被子。

transcript.en_text: God, we were living like heathens.
transcript.zh_text: 天哪，我们那时候过得像野蛮人一样。

transcript.en_text: Well, because we were spending everything we had on the race.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，因为我们把所有的钱都花在选举上了。

transcript.en_text: I remember I used to think this place was a palace, though.
transcript.zh_text: 我记得那时我觉得这个地方是宫殿。

transcript.en_text: - It was. - Not compared to the ranch.
transcript.zh_text: ——确实是。——跟牧场比不算什么。

transcript.en_text: Well, it was a palace because it was ours.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，它是宫殿因为它是我们的。

transcript.en_text: Good night, Francis.
transcript.zh_text: 晚安，弗朗西斯。

transcript.en_text: The press has surrounded the house.
transcript.zh_text: 媒体把房子围了。

transcript.en_text: I can't leave the damn place until I know exactly what I'm gonna say.
transcript.zh_text: 我不知道要说什么之前，没法离开这该死的房子。

transcript.en_text: We need to cancel your events.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要取消你的活动。

transcript.en_text: Of course we need to cancel my events.
transcript.zh_text: 当然需要取消我的活动。

transcript.en_text: - The expression on my face is a-- - What's going on?
transcript.zh_text: ——我脸上的表情就是—— ——怎么了？

transcript.en_text: ...taken in a nondescript location, does not seem to be a direct endorsement for the KKK.
transcript.zh_text: ……拍摄地点不明，似乎不是对三K党的直接支持。

transcript.en_text: - My God. - My father.
transcript.zh_text: ——天哪。——我父亲。

transcript.en_text: Sir? Congresswoman Jones is heading back to Texas.
transcript.zh_text: 先生？琼斯女议员正在赶回德州。

transcript.en_text: Get her on the phone for me, right now. Meechum, I need you to do me a favor.
transcript.zh_text: 马上给我接通她的电话。米查姆，我需要你帮个忙。

transcript.en_text: There are no clues at the moment as to who may be responsible, but Gaffney PD is taking the canvas picture down within the hour for further examination.
transcript.zh_text: 目前没有线索表明谁可能是责任人，但加夫尼警方将在一小时内取下那幅画布进行进一步调查。

transcript.en_text: On primary day.
transcript.zh_text: 在初选日。

transcript.en_text: I can't verify anything yet in terms of who it is, or even whether it's real, or--
transcript.zh_text: 在这个人是谁，甚至是否是真的方面，我还无法核实——

transcript.en_text: The day before New Hampshire, there's a marriage story, and now in South Carolina we have this?
transcript.zh_text: 新罕布什尔州前一天有婚姻丑闻，现在南卡又有这个？

transcript.en_text: Uh, how are we getting blindsided?
transcript.zh_text: 呃，我们怎么总是被打个措手不及？

transcript.en_text: - I should get that-- - Let it ring.
transcript.zh_text: ——我应该接那个—— ——让它响。

transcript.en_text: Look...
transcript.zh_text: 听着……

transcript.en_text: I didn't even know about the fight until you told me.
transcript.zh_text: 你告诉我之前我都不知道那次争吵的事。

transcript.en_text: And how was I supposed to know about this photo?
transcript.zh_text: 那我怎么可能知道这张照片？

transcript.en_text: Because it is your job to get out ahead of this shit.
transcript.zh_text: 因为提前发现这些烂事是你的工作。

highlights.en_word: get out ahead of this shit

transcript.en_text: The oppo team should've tracked this down. That's the campaign.
transcript.zh_text: 反对派调查团队应该已经查到了。那是竞选团队的事。

transcript.en_text: So, if Vaughn didn't know, or the president didn't tell him...
transcript.zh_text: 所以如果沃恩不知道，或者总统没告诉他……

transcript.en_text: It has to be somebody close to him. Someone with a lot of access.
transcript.zh_text: 那一定是他身边的人。有很多接触机会的人。

transcript.en_text: The president's on the line.
transcript.zh_text: 总统在线了。

transcript.en_text: Sir, it's Doug. I'm in here with Seth.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，是道格。赛斯和我在一起。

transcript.en_text: I'm gonna tell the truth. I'm gonna say it is my father.
transcript.zh_text: 我要说实话。我要说那是我父亲。

transcript.en_text: That's probably the best response, if you have a good way to frame it.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你有好的表述方式，这可能是最好的回应。

transcript.en_text: I know what to say. The question is where.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道说什么。问题是在哪说。

transcript.en_text: One-on-one. Something exclusive.
transcript.zh_text: 一对一。独家的。

transcript.en_text: Not in front of the media. I need to connect directly to the voters, the African American voters.
transcript.zh_text: 不要面对媒体。我需要直接跟选民对话，非裔美国选民。

transcript.en_text: Mr. President, I've got the Secretary of State.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生，国务卿在线。

transcript.en_text: I'll call her back.
transcript.zh_text: 我晚点再打给她。

transcript.en_text: Hang on, boys. Meechum?
transcript.zh_text: 等一下，伙计们。米查姆？

transcript.en_text: It's here, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 在这里，先生。

transcript.en_text: What can you tell me?
transcript.zh_text: 你查到什么了？

transcript.en_text: Yesterday, a woman named Leslie McIntyre opened a new box.
transcript.zh_text: 昨天一个叫莱斯利·麦金太尔的女人开了一个新的保险箱。

transcript.en_text: I'm having the name run now, but it looks like she used a fake social.
transcript.zh_text: 我正在查这个名字，但看起来她用了假的社会安全号。

transcript.en_text: What about security footage?
transcript.zh_text: 监控录像呢？

transcript.en_text: They reset the cameras every morning.
transcript.zh_text: 他们每天早上重置摄像头。

transcript.en_text: I asked what she looked like and all the manager said is that it was a Caucasian brunette.
transcript.zh_text: 我问了她长什么样，经理只说是一个白人棕发女性。

transcript.en_text: Nothing strange about her.
transcript.zh_text: 她没什么异常。

transcript.en_text: All right. Bring the box back here. Don't let it out of your sight.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。把保险箱带回来。别让它离开你的视线。

transcript.en_text: As far as I know, there's only one photograph.
transcript.zh_text: 据我所知，只有一张照片。

transcript.en_text: Meechum says it's still at the bank.
transcript.zh_text: 米查姆说照片还在银行。

transcript.en_text: Sir, it's just me.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，就我一个人。

transcript.en_text: Are you thinking what I'm thinking?
transcript.zh_text: 你在想我想的那件事吗？

transcript.en_text: Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，先生。

transcript.en_text: Well, you keep an eye on him.
transcript.zh_text: 好，你盯着他。

transcript.en_text: I want emails and phone records of everyone in the White House.
transcript.zh_text: 我要白宫所有人的邮件和通话记录。

transcript.en_text: Including yours.
transcript.zh_text: 包括你的。

transcript.en_text: Mine? You honestly think-- Is there a problem?
transcript.zh_text: 我的？你真的觉得—— 有问题吗？

transcript.en_text: No.
transcript.zh_text: 没有。

transcript.en_text: Good.
transcript.zh_text: 好。

transcript.en_text: It's unfortunate.
transcript.zh_text: 真不幸。

transcript.en_text: Ms. Dunbar! Ms. Dunbar? Ms. Dunbar?
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士！邓巴女士？邓巴女士？

transcript.en_text: The imagery...
transcript.zh_text: 那些画面……

transcript.en_text: That anyone would try to inflame racial discord by doing something so base.
transcript.zh_text: 任何人试图通过做这种卑劣的事来煽动种族不和。

transcript.en_text: Whether it's Calvin Underwood isn't the point.
transcript.zh_text: 是否是卡尔文·安德伍德不是重点。

transcript.en_text: If it is, and we have no confirmation on that, I mean... Who put this up? And why?
transcript.zh_text: 如果是的话，而且我们还没有确认……我是说，谁贴上去的？为什么？

transcript.en_text: Who knows. And the sins of the father aren't necessarily the sins of the son.
transcript.zh_text: 谁知道呢。而且父亲的罪过不一定是儿子的罪过。

transcript.en_text: But... it's troubling. Very troubling.
transcript.zh_text: 但是……这很令人不安。非常令人不安。

transcript.en_text: Stunts like these have the potential to open old wounds.
transcript.zh_text: 这种噱头有可能揭开旧伤疤。

transcript.en_text: We can't let that happen. We need to rise above it.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不能让那种事发生。我们需要超越它。

transcript.en_text: Make clear, no matter who you support, that this sort of behavior will not be tolerated.
transcript.zh_text: 表明立场，无论你支持谁，这种行为都不会被容忍。

transcript.en_text: Get me Reverend Clark and Gene Clancy on the phone.
transcript.zh_text: 帮我接克拉克牧师和吉恩·克兰西。

transcript.en_text: Hey, they want you out by the bus.
transcript.zh_text: 嘿，他们要你去巴士那边。

transcript.en_text: By the bus?
transcript.zh_text: 巴士那边？

transcript.en_text: - Um, who are you? - Sorry.
transcript.zh_text: ——嗯，你是谁？——抱歉。

transcript.en_text: Mark from the Butler County office.
transcript.zh_text: 巴特勒郡办公室的马克。

transcript.en_text: They want all the Cincinnati volunteers to gather by the bus for a photo with Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 他们要所有辛辛那提的志愿者在巴士那集合跟邓巴合影。

transcript.en_text: Jenn told me I wasn't supposed to leave-- That's why she sent me. She didn't want you to miss the photo. Go.
transcript.zh_text: 珍告诉我我不应该离开—— 所以她才派我来的。她不想你错过合影。去吧。

transcript.en_text: Out by the bus?
transcript.zh_text: 去巴士那边？

transcript.en_text: She told me to cover for you.
transcript.zh_text: 她让我替你顶着。

transcript.en_text: Okay, um...
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，嗯……

transcript.en_text: well, there were a couple of no-shows, but, you know, otherwise, everyone's here.
transcript.zh_text: 有几个人没来，但是其他人都到了。

transcript.en_text: - Okay. Thanks. - Very convenient. Thanks.
transcript.zh_text: ——好的。谢谢。——真方便。谢谢。

transcript.en_text: Enjoy.
transcript.zh_text: 请便。

transcript.en_text: I'm David Grimes with the Cleveland Plain Dealer.
transcript.zh_text: 我是大卫·格莱姆斯，克利夫兰《每日新闻》的。

transcript.en_text: Where's your credential?
transcript.zh_text: 你的证件呢？

transcript.en_text: I was an idiot and left it in the car.
transcript.zh_text: 我太蠢了，忘在车里了。

transcript.en_text: They recognized me at the check-in desk, though.
transcript.zh_text: 不过他们在登记处认出我了。

transcript.en_text: I can direct you to the bullpen, but this area is off-limits to the press.
transcript.zh_text: 我可以带你去记者区，但这个区域对媒体是禁止进入的。

transcript.en_text: I'm actually supposed to do an interview with Cynthia Driscoll.
transcript.zh_text: 实际上我应该是来采访辛西娅·德里斯科尔的。

transcript.en_text: The Advance guys said I should come this way.
transcript.zh_text: 先遣队的人说我应该走这边。

transcript.en_text: Wait here.
transcript.zh_text: 在这等着。

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry, Mr. President, we just can't do it.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生，我们真的做不到。

transcript.en_text: Forty-five percent of the vote here is African American.
transcript.zh_text: 这里百分之四十五的选票是非裔美国人的。

transcript.en_text: You and your mother standing by my side would go a long way to put this-- I am running for Congress in a black and Latino district.
transcript.zh_text: 你和你母亲站在我身边对平息这件事很有帮助—— 我要在一个黑人和拉丁裔选区竞选国会。

transcript.en_text: My mother was beaten and hosed down in marches.
transcript.zh_text: 我母亲在游行中被殴打和用水管冲。

transcript.en_text: You want us to vouch for a man whose father was in the KKK?
transcript.zh_text: 你要我们为一个父亲是三K党的人担保？

transcript.en_text: - No, he was not in the Klan. - That was him in that picture.
transcript.zh_text: ——不，他不是三K党成员。——照片里就是他。

transcript.en_text: Yes, but I've explained that.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，但我已经解释过了。

transcript.en_text: This is the state where the Civil War started, where you can still see rebel flags on bumper stickers.
transcript.zh_text: 这是南北战争开始的州，你仍然能在保险杠贴纸上看到南方邦联旗。

transcript.en_text: There is a history of racist brutality here, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 这里有种族主义暴行的历史，总统先生。

transcript.en_text: Those sort of symbols matter.
transcript.zh_text: 那些符号很重要。

transcript.en_text: Could you put your mother on, please?
transcript.zh_text: 能让你母亲接电话吗？

transcript.en_text: Mom?
transcript.zh_text: 妈？

transcript.en_text: He wants to speak to you.
transcript.zh_text: 他想跟你说话。

transcript.en_text: Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生。

transcript.en_text: Listen, we need to stand together. Now, I've endorsed Celia.
transcript.zh_text: 听着，我们需要团结一致。我已经为西莉亚背书了。

transcript.en_text: Claire can do a great deal for her in Texas.
transcript.zh_text: 克莱尔能在德州为她做很多。

transcript.en_text: She's better off without the Underwoods at this point.
transcript.zh_text: 到了这个地步，她不跟安德伍德家绑在一起反而更好。

transcript.en_text: But what about your clinic?
transcript.zh_text: 但你的诊所呢？

transcript.en_text: Imagine how that would look, holding our clinic for ransom.
transcript.zh_text: 想想看，把我们的诊所当人质来要挟，那该多难看。

transcript.en_text: I'm appealing to your goodwill, Congresswoman.
transcript.zh_text: 我恳请你的善意，女议员。

transcript.en_text: When we stop getting beaten and shot...
transcript.zh_text: 等我们不再被殴打和枪杀的时候……

transcript.en_text: you'll have my goodwill, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 你才会得到我的善意，总统先生。

transcript.en_text: Goodbye.
transcript.zh_text: 再见。

transcript.en_text: Get me Gene Clancy again.
transcript.zh_text: 再帮我接吉恩·克兰西。

transcript.en_text: What if it's Oren Chase, Francis?
transcript.zh_text: 如果是奥伦·蔡斯呢，弗朗西斯？

transcript.en_text: He could've gotten his hands on a copy. There may be more than one.
transcript.zh_text: 他可能拿到了一份副本。也许不止一张。

transcript.en_text: Meechum first, then Clancy.
transcript.zh_text: 先找米查姆，然后克兰西。

transcript.en_text: Lucas?
transcript.zh_text: 卢卡斯？

transcript.en_text: We need to talk.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要谈谈。

transcript.en_text: - I thought you were-- - I was. I'm... I'm out now.
transcript.zh_text: ——我以为你在—— ——我以前是的。我……我现在出来了。

transcript.en_text: This is important.
transcript.zh_text: 这很重要。

transcript.en_text: Mr. President, was your father a racist?
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生，你父亲是种族主义者吗？

transcript.en_text: Was your father a racist?
transcript.zh_text: 你父亲是种族主义者吗？

transcript.en_text: Mrs. Underwood, is your mother okay?
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德夫人，你母亲还好吗？

transcript.en_text: Mr. President!
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生！

transcript.en_text: - Mr. Chase? - Who are you?
transcript.zh_text: ——蔡斯先生？——你是谁？

transcript.en_text: United States Secret Service.
transcript.zh_text: 美国特勤局。

transcript.en_text: We're not after you, Mr. Chase. We're after whoever put you up to it.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不是来找你的，蔡斯先生。我们要找的是指使你的人。

transcript.en_text: Put me up to what?
transcript.zh_text: 指使我干什么？

transcript.en_text: You can answer me here, or we can go to the Columbia field office for questioning.
transcript.zh_text: 你可以在这里回答我，或者我们可以去哥伦比亚办事处接受问话。

transcript.en_text: I have no idea what you're talking about.
transcript.zh_text: 我完全不知道你在说什么。

transcript.en_text: All right, I need you to come with me, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，先生，我需要你跟我来。

transcript.en_text: - Now, hold on. - Step outside, sir.
transcript.zh_text: ——等一下。——请到外面，先生。

transcript.en_text: I wanna talk to a lawyer.
transcript.zh_text: 我要跟律师谈。

transcript.en_text: - I need backup at 4126. - Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey.
transcript.zh_text: ——我需要4126的支援。——嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

transcript.en_text: - Come on, that's not necessary. - Not if you cooperate, sir.
transcript.zh_text: ——拜托，没必要这样。——如果你配合的话就没必要，先生。

transcript.en_text: If I talk to you, I won't get in trouble?
transcript.zh_text: 如果我跟你说了，我就不会有麻烦了？

transcript.en_text: I swear to God, Ms. Dunbar. It's all true.
transcript.zh_text: 我发誓，邓巴女士。全都是真的。

transcript.en_text: Then where's the proof?
transcript.zh_text: 那证据呢？

transcript.en_text: I don't have the means, but you do.
transcript.zh_text: 我没有手段，但你有。

transcript.en_text: You've investigated him before. You know he's dangerous.
transcript.zh_text: 你以前调查过他。你知道他很危险。

transcript.en_text: Mr. Goodwin-- Why would he go after me if I wasn't onto something?
transcript.zh_text: 古德温先生—— 如果我没查到什么，他为什么要来对付我？

transcript.en_text: This was a high-level sting operation.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一场高级别的诱捕行动。

transcript.en_text: Major resources were dedicated to it.
transcript.zh_text: 投入了大量资源。

transcript.en_text: I'm... I was a journalist, no criminal record.
transcript.zh_text: 我……我曾经是记者，没有犯罪记录。

transcript.en_text: How am I suddenly such a threat, unless I'm-- Even if I did believe you, I am no longer part of the DOJ. I am a private citizen now.
transcript.zh_text: 我怎么突然就变成了这么大的威胁，除非我—— 即使我相信你，我已经不是司法部的人了。我现在是普通公民。

transcript.en_text: Who's running for president-- Aren't you breaking WITSEC protocol by being here?
transcript.zh_text: 一个正在竞选总统的人—— 你来这里不是违反了证人保护协议吗？

transcript.en_text: I am no longer comfortable with this.
transcript.zh_text: 我对这件事不太放心了。

transcript.en_text: - You're... you're my last chance. Please! - Hey, hey.
transcript.zh_text: ——你是……你是我最后的希望了。求求你！——嘿嘿。

transcript.en_text: - I suggest that you go back home. - I'm... The things I've-- - Don't make us get security involved. - Please. Just-- Just give us five minutes until she's out of the building.
transcript.zh_text: ——我建议你回家去。——我…… 我做的那些事—— ——别让我们叫保安。——求求你。等等—— 给我们五分钟，等她离开大楼。

transcript.en_text: Please. Please listen to me.
transcript.zh_text: 求求你。请听我说。

transcript.en_text: I'm... I'm begging you.
transcript.zh_text: 我……我求求你了。

transcript.en_text: Just help me...
transcript.zh_text: 帮帮我就好……

transcript.en_text: Help.
transcript.zh_text: 帮帮忙。

transcript.en_text: Please, please...
transcript.zh_text: 求求你，求求你……

transcript.en_text: Oh, God...
transcript.zh_text: 天哪……

transcript.en_text: How could you put me in a room with him?
transcript.zh_text: 你怎么能让我跟他待在一个房间里？

transcript.en_text: I didn't know what he was gonna say.
transcript.zh_text: 我不知道他要说什么。

transcript.en_text: But I assumed that if he went to such great lengths-- The DUI, that's all he has proof of. That's nothing.
transcript.zh_text: 但我觉得既然他费了这么大的劲—— 那个酒驾，这就是他唯一的证据。这算不了什么。

transcript.en_text: Even I have helped people get off for that.
transcript.zh_text: 连我都帮人免过那种罪。

transcript.en_text: - There's the affair... - With no evidence.
transcript.zh_text: ——还有那个婚外情……——没有证据。

transcript.en_text: Then he leaps to murder... Two murders?
transcript.zh_text: 然后他就跳到谋杀……两起谋杀？

transcript.en_text: The man is troubled.
transcript.zh_text: 这个人精神有问题。

transcript.en_text: We saw the look in his eye.
transcript.zh_text: 我们看到了他眼中的表情。

transcript.en_text: I thought he might have something real.
transcript.zh_text: 我以为他可能有些实质性的东西。

transcript.en_text: He used to be a good editor.
transcript.zh_text: 他以前是个好编辑。

transcript.en_text: And now he is a convicted felon.
transcript.zh_text: 而现在他是个被定罪的重犯。

transcript.en_text: You said no stone unturned.
transcript.zh_text: 你说过不留任何石头不翻。

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry, I should have thought better of it.
transcript.zh_text: 对不起，我应该想清楚再做。

transcript.en_text: Yes, you should have.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，你应该的。

transcript.en_text: Let's let it go. How are we doing in South Carolina?
transcript.zh_text: 算了吧。南卡罗来纳那边怎么样了？

transcript.en_text: Early exit polls are good.
transcript.zh_text: 早期出口民调不错。

transcript.en_text: - We have a shot at winning. - Actually winning?
transcript.zh_text: ——我们有可能赢。——真的能赢？

transcript.en_text: That billboard's done real damage.
transcript.zh_text: 那个广告牌造成了很大伤害。

transcript.en_text: I appreciate you doing this, Gene. You're really saving my life here.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你帮忙，吉恩。你真的救了我一命。

transcript.en_text: Just remember it when I run for county executive.
transcript.zh_text: 等我竞选郡长的时候记得还这个人情。

transcript.en_text: I'll be down here whenever you need me.
transcript.zh_text: 你什么时候需要我我随时都在。

transcript.en_text: Oh, it's not the when, it's the what. And how much.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，不是什么时候的问题，是什么事的问题。还有多少钱。

transcript.en_text: Afternoon, Oren.
transcript.zh_text: 下午好，奥伦。

transcript.en_text: - Mr. President. - Have a seat.
transcript.zh_text: ——总统先生。——坐。

transcript.en_text: Didn't you learn your lesson with all that Peachoid nonsense?
transcript.zh_text: 桃子水塔那件蠢事都没让你吸取教训吗？

transcript.en_text: Well, you promised to help me with the 4th.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，你答应过帮我搞独立日庆典的。

transcript.en_text: I let my bitterness get the better of me.
transcript.zh_text: 我让自己的怨恨占了上风。

highlights.en_word: let my bitterness get the better of me

transcript.en_text: Mmm-hmm.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯哼。

transcript.en_text: Who specifically approached you? A woman?
transcript.zh_text: 具体是谁联系你的？一个女人？

transcript.en_text: - Brunette? - Yeah.
transcript.zh_text: ——棕发？——是的。

transcript.en_text: Uh, about so tall, good-looking.
transcript.zh_text: 呃，差不多这么高，长得不错。

transcript.en_text: Wouldn't give me her name.
transcript.zh_text: 不肯告诉我她的名字。

transcript.en_text: We should get photos of everyone in Dunbar's staff that fits that description.
transcript.zh_text: 我们应该调出邓巴团队里符合这个描述的所有人的照片。

transcript.en_text: Already compiling it, ma'am.
transcript.zh_text: 已经在整理了，夫人。

transcript.en_text: And as for you...
transcript.zh_text: 至于你……

transcript.en_text: you're gonna plant yourself in front of as many TV cameras that can gather around that bony ass of yours.
transcript.zh_text: 你要站到尽可能多的电视摄像机前面去。

transcript.en_text: You're gonna be wracked with guilt and overcome with conscience.
transcript.zh_text: 你要表现得愧疚不已、良心发现。

transcript.en_text: And you do that and I'll make sure that you aren't charged.
transcript.zh_text: 你这么做了，我就确保你不会被起诉。

transcript.en_text: You want me to say it was Dunbar?
transcript.zh_text: 你要我说是邓巴干的？

transcript.en_text: Come on, be smarter than that, Oren. She'll sue you for slander.
transcript.zh_text: 拜托聪明点，奥伦。她会告你诽谤。

transcript.en_text: Just say you were bought and people will connect the dots on their own.
transcript.zh_text: 你只要说你被人收买了，大家自然会把线索串起来的。

transcript.en_text: Get him out of here.
transcript.zh_text: 带他出去。

transcript.en_text: I hope you don't welsh on your promise to me the way you did with Oren.
transcript.zh_text: 我希望你不会像对奥伦那样对我食言。

transcript.en_text: You're family, Gene. I would never betray one of the family.
transcript.zh_text: 你是家人，吉恩。我绝不会背叛家人。

transcript.en_text: Shall we?
transcript.zh_text: 我们走？

transcript.en_text: Ready?
transcript.zh_text: 准备好了？

transcript.en_text: Many of you voted for me for mayor because you've known me your whole lives.
transcript.zh_text: 你们很多人投票选我当市长，因为你们认识了我一辈子。

transcript.en_text: Well, I've known Frank Underwood my whole life.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我认识弗兰克·安德伍德也一辈子了。

transcript.en_text: He's my friend and I trust him, and I don't care what's on that billboard.
transcript.zh_text: 他是我的朋友，我信任他，我不在乎广告牌上是什么。

transcript.en_text: I'm proud he's my president, and I'm proud to have... be standing with him here today.
transcript.zh_text: 我为他是我的总统感到骄傲，我也为……今天能跟他站在一起感到骄傲。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, Gene.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你，吉恩。

transcript.en_text: Yesterday, I stood in this church...
transcript.zh_text: 昨天，我站在这间教堂里……

transcript.en_text: and I talked about community.
transcript.zh_text: 我谈了社区。

transcript.en_text: I talked about our collective strength, black and white, coming together during times of crisis.
transcript.zh_text: 我谈了黑人和白人在危机时刻团结在一起的集体力量。

transcript.en_text: And today there's probably a lot of you who think I'm a hypocrite.
transcript.zh_text: 今天你们中可能有很多人觉得我是个伪君子。

transcript.en_text: How can a man whose father was in the KKK stand up here and mean the things he said?
transcript.zh_text: 一个父亲是三K党的人怎么能站在这里，说的话是真心的？

transcript.en_text: Yes, that is my father in that photograph, I'm not going to deny it.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，照片里的那个人是我父亲，我不会否认。

transcript.en_text: But the truth is he wasn't in the Klan.
transcript.zh_text: 但事实是他不是三K党成员。

transcript.en_text: The year that photo was taken, my father needed $5,000 to pay off our debts, or the bank was gonna foreclose on our farm.
transcript.zh_text: 那张照片拍的那年，我父亲需要5000美元来还债，否则银行就要没收我们的农场。

transcript.en_text: Now, my father went to every other bank within a hundred miles of here, and no one would give him a loan.
transcript.zh_text: 我父亲去了方圆一百英里内的每一家银行，没有人愿意给他贷款。

transcript.en_text: He asked friends, he asked family, but nobody had that kind of money.
transcript.zh_text: 他问了朋友，问了亲戚，但没人有那么多钱。

transcript.en_text: And we were about to lose everything.
transcript.zh_text: 我们就要失去一切了。

transcript.en_text: Now, at the time, the owner of the Gaffney First Bank was a member of the Klan.
transcript.zh_text: 当时，加夫尼第一银行的老板是三K党成员。

transcript.en_text: Some of you know that.
transcript.zh_text: 你们有些人知道这件事。

transcript.en_text: And he would do whatever the Klan told him to do, and my father knew that.
transcript.zh_text: 三K党叫他做什么他就做什么，我父亲知道这一点。

transcript.en_text: So my father did what he had to do.
transcript.zh_text: 所以我父亲做了他不得不做的事。

transcript.en_text: He went to a meeting and begged the leader of that chapter to talk to the owner of the bank.
transcript.zh_text: 他去参加了一次聚会，求那个分会的头目去跟银行老板说情。

transcript.en_text: And at that meeting, that's when that photograph was taken.
transcript.zh_text: 就是在那次聚会上，那张照片被拍了下来。

transcript.en_text: The only reason he was there was to try to save our farm.
transcript.zh_text: 他去那里的唯一原因是想保住我们的农场。

transcript.en_text: Now, Calvin Underwood hated himself for going to that meeting.
transcript.zh_text: 卡尔文·安德伍德恨自己去了那次聚会。

transcript.en_text: He hated himself for taking that photograph.
transcript.zh_text: 他恨自己拍了那张照片。

transcript.en_text: But he would've hated himself even more if he'd lost our farm...
transcript.zh_text: 但如果失去了农场，他会更恨自己……

transcript.en_text: if he hadn't been able to provide and support his family.
transcript.zh_text: 如果他没能养家糊口的话。

transcript.en_text: Now, look, I'm not trying to ask you to forgive him being in that photograph.
transcript.zh_text: 听着，我不是让你们原谅他出现在那张照片里。

transcript.en_text: He probably thought no one would ever see it.
transcript.zh_text: 他大概以为永远不会有人看到那张照片。

transcript.en_text: But I am asking you to empathize with his predicament.
transcript.zh_text: 但我请求你们理解他的困境。

transcript.en_text: And ask yourselves...
transcript.zh_text: 问问你们自己……

transcript.en_text: what would you do to save your family?
transcript.zh_text: 你们会为了保住家人做什么？

transcript.en_text: Now, whoever stole that photograph and vandalized that billboard, they're not trying to unearth some big scandal about my past, 'cause it just isn't true.
transcript.zh_text: 偷了那张照片并破坏了广告牌的人，他们不是要揭露我过去的什么大丑闻，因为那根本不是真的。

transcript.en_text: What they're trying to do is divide us.
transcript.zh_text: 他们想做的是分裂我们。

transcript.en_text: What they really wanna succeed in doing is making sure you don't vote for me today.
transcript.zh_text: 他们真正想做到的是确保你们今天不投票给我。

transcript.en_text: They've gone to a whole lot of trouble to make me look pretty bad.
transcript.zh_text: 他们费了很大的劲想让我难堪。

highlights.en_word: gone to a whole lot of trouble

transcript.en_text: But that's politics.
transcript.zh_text: 但那就是政治。

transcript.en_text: My hope in coming here today...
transcript.zh_text: 我今天来这里的初衷……

transcript.en_text: and speaking openly and honestly about this...
transcript.zh_text: 公开、坦诚地谈论这件事……

transcript.en_text: is that we can stay united.
transcript.zh_text: 是希望我们能保持团结。

transcript.en_text: So my plan is to stay here as long as it takes, to speak to each one of you individually, and answer every question that you might have.
transcript.zh_text: 所以我打算待在这里多久就待多久，单独跟你们每个人谈，回答你们可能有的每一个问题。

transcript.en_text: Thank you very much.
transcript.zh_text: 非常感谢。

transcript.en_text: Thank you very much, ma'am.
transcript.zh_text: 非常感谢你，女士。

transcript.en_text: President Underwood, speaking live in his home town of Gaffney, South Carolina, addressing claims that his father was a member of the Ku Klux Klan.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德总统，在家乡南卡罗来纳的加夫尼现场讲话，回应其父亲是三K党成员的指控。

transcript.en_text: A billboard there was vandalized late last night with a photo of his father standing next to a man in Klan robes with the caption, "Underwood 2016."
transcript.zh_text: 当地一个广告牌昨晚被喷上了他父亲站在一个穿三K党长袍的人旁边的照片，配文是'安德伍德2016'。

transcript.en_text: As we've just seen, the president did not deny allegations that his father had some connection to the organization, instead explaining that Calvin Underwood attended one meeting
transcript.zh_text: 正如我们刚才所见，总统没有否认父亲与该组织有某种关联的指控，而是解释说卡尔文·安德伍德参加了一次聚会

transcript.en_text: as a last resort to save his family's peach farm from foreclosure.
transcript.zh_text: 作为拯救家族桃园免于被银行没收的最后手段。

transcript.en_text: The president was subject to widespread criticism after news of his family's alleged Klan connection broke this morning.
transcript.zh_text: 在今天早上家族涉嫌与三K党有关的消息爆出后，总统遭到了广泛批评。

transcript.en_text: Today's primary result will show-- I don't know her name. I asked, but she wouldn't tell me.
transcript.zh_text: 今天的初选结果将显示—— 我不知道她的名字。我问了但她不肯告诉我。

transcript.en_text: And I deeply regret that I allowed my political leanings to compromise my better judgment.
transcript.zh_text: 我深切地后悔自己让政治倾向影响了我的判断力。

transcript.en_text: I want to apologize to anyone I might have offended by hoisting up such painful imagery.
transcript.zh_text: 我想向所有可能被这种痛苦画面冒犯到的人道歉。

transcript.en_text: We're getting calls asking if it was us.
transcript.zh_text: 我们接到电话问是不是我们干的。

transcript.en_text: - Do you think someone from our team-- - Absolutely not.
transcript.zh_text: ——你觉得我们团队里有人—— ——绝对不是。

transcript.en_text: I think Underwood put this guy up to it.
transcript.zh_text: 我觉得是安德伍德让那个人这么干的。

highlights.en_word: put this guy up to it

transcript.en_text: He's trying to turn this back around on us.
transcript.zh_text: 他想把事情倒打一耙到我们头上。

highlights.en_word: turn this back around on us

transcript.en_text: We need to deny, forcefully.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要强力否认。

transcript.en_text: I'm already putting a press avail together at your next event.
transcript.zh_text: 我已经在你下一个活动安排记者会了。

transcript.en_text: Maybe we need to reconsider Goodwin.
transcript.zh_text: 也许我们需要重新考虑古德温。

transcript.en_text: - What do you have in mind? - I'm not sure.
transcript.zh_text: ——你有什么打算？——我不确定。

transcript.en_text: Mmm.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯。

transcript.en_text: Look at this.
transcript.zh_text: 看看这个。

transcript.en_text: It came from the goddamn White House!
transcript.zh_text: 这照片他妈的是从白宫流出来的！

transcript.en_text: We're questioning the photographer now, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 我们正在审问那个摄影师，先生。

transcript.en_text: I've got a statement prepared that this was a run-of-the-mill event, that you took photos with lots of re-enactors.
transcript.zh_text: 我已经准备了一份声明，说这只是一次普通活动，你跟很多历史扮演者合了影。

transcript.en_text: It doesn't matter how you spin it.
transcript.zh_text: 怎么包装都没用。

transcript.en_text: I just stood in front of a group of African Americans in a church, asking them to believe in me.
transcript.zh_text: 我刚在一群非裔美国人面前，在一座教堂里，请求他们相信我。

transcript.en_text: It's bad enough they see my father next to a Klansman.
transcript.zh_text: 他们看到我父亲站在三K党成员旁边已经够糟了。

transcript.en_text: Now they see me next to a symbol of slavery.
transcript.zh_text: 现在他们又看到我站在一个奴隶制象征旁边。

transcript.en_text: I wanna find out who's leaking this shit, and I want their head on a goddamn stake!
transcript.zh_text: 我要查出谁在泄露这些东西，我要他的人头！

transcript.en_text: Sir, I have a theory.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，我有一个推测。

transcript.en_text: I think...
transcript.zh_text: 我觉得……

transcript.en_text: Well, I think it might be Edward Meechum.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我觉得可能是爱德华·米查姆。

transcript.en_text: Meechum?
transcript.zh_text: 米查姆？

transcript.en_text: He knew about the argument between you and the First Lady.
transcript.zh_text: 他知道你和第一夫人之间的争吵。

transcript.en_text: He was there on that trip to Virginia.
transcript.zh_text: 他在弗吉尼亚那次旅行中也在场。

transcript.en_text: - He would never do something like this. - Dunbar has a lot of money.
transcript.zh_text: ——他绝不会做这种事。——邓巴有很多钱。

transcript.en_text: Put out a statement to the networks that I won't be giving a concession speech.
transcript.zh_text: 向各电视台发声明，我不会发表认输演讲。

transcript.en_text: Sir... don't you think that might look like you're running from-- I just lost my home state. I'm not gonna rake myself over the coals.
transcript.zh_text: 先生……你不觉得这看起来像是在逃避—— 我刚输了自己的家乡州。我不打算自我鞭笞。

transcript.en_text: Meechum?
transcript.zh_text: 米查姆？

transcript.en_text: I'm not ruling anyone out.
transcript.zh_text: 我没有排除任何人。

transcript.en_text: Sir?
transcript.zh_text: 先生？

transcript.en_text: I brought the safety deposit box for you.
transcript.zh_text: 我把保险箱带来了。

transcript.en_text: You can put it down.
transcript.zh_text: 你可以放下了。

transcript.en_text: - Meechum. - Yes, sir?
transcript.zh_text: ——米查姆。——什么事，先生？

transcript.en_text: Have I given you any reason to hurt me?
transcript.zh_text: 我有没有给你什么理由来伤害我？

transcript.en_text: Hurt you, sir?
transcript.zh_text: 伤害您，先生？

transcript.en_text: Have I done you wrong in any way?
transcript.zh_text: 我有没有对不起你？

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry, sir, I don't understand.
transcript.zh_text: 对不起先生，我不明白。

transcript.en_text: Look me in the eyes, Meechum.
transcript.zh_text: 看着我的眼睛，米查姆。

transcript.en_text: - Sir... - Meechum, shh.
transcript.zh_text: ——先生……——米查姆，嘘。

transcript.en_text: Are you all right, sir?
transcript.zh_text: 你还好吗，先生？

transcript.en_text: I've been better.
transcript.zh_text: 我经历过更好的时候。

transcript.en_text: I'm still on duty.
transcript.zh_text: 我还在值班。

transcript.en_text: Is there...
transcript.zh_text: 有没有……

transcript.en_text: anything I can do?
transcript.zh_text: 什么我能做的？

transcript.en_text: You could go out and stuff some ballot boxes for me.
transcript.zh_text: 你可以出去帮我往投票箱里塞选票。

highlights.zh_word: 在投票箱里塞选票（舞弊）

transcript.en_text: - You'll bounce back from this. - I sure hope I can.
transcript.zh_text: ——你会从这件事中恢复过来的。——我希望如此。

transcript.en_text: Uh, when I got fired...
transcript.zh_text: 呃，当我被解雇的时候……

transcript.en_text: from the Capitol Police...
transcript.zh_text: 从国会警察……

transcript.en_text: I mean, I know it doesn't compare, but...
transcript.zh_text: 我知道跟你的情况没法比，但是……

transcript.en_text: I felt pretty bad.
transcript.zh_text: 我觉得很糟。

transcript.en_text: I thought my career was over.
transcript.zh_text: 我以为我的职业生涯结束了。

transcript.en_text: Then you turned everything around.
transcript.zh_text: 然后你扭转了一切。

transcript.en_text: You don't get second chances in elections.
transcript.zh_text: 选举中你没有第二次机会。

transcript.en_text: I know.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道。

transcript.en_text: But there's a lot of primaries ahead.
transcript.zh_text: 但后面还有很多场初选。

transcript.en_text: All I'm saying is it's not over. You'll get through this.
transcript.zh_text: 我只是说还没结束。你会挺过去的。

transcript.en_text: - I'm sorry, that must sound so stupid. - No, it doesn't.
transcript.zh_text: ——对不起，这听起来一定很蠢。——不，不蠢。

transcript.en_text: I appreciate it.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你。

transcript.en_text: I'll be out by the motorcade, sir, if you need anything.
transcript.zh_text: 我在车队旁边待着，先生，如果您需要什么的话。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, Meechum.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你，米查姆。

transcript.en_text: I knew it, but I didn't wanna believe it.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道的，但我不想承认。

transcript.en_text: It's only a wound.
transcript.zh_text: 这只是一道伤口。

transcript.en_text: It's not fatal.
transcript.zh_text: 不是致命的。

transcript.en_text: My home state, Claire.
transcript.zh_text: 我的家乡州，克莱尔。

transcript.en_text: Have a seat.
transcript.zh_text: 坐。

transcript.en_text: I end your race so you end mine?
transcript.zh_text: 我终结了你的竞选，所以你终结了我的？

transcript.en_text: - Let me explain, Francis. - Spite, revenge!
transcript.zh_text: ——让我解释，弗朗西斯。——怀恨报复！

transcript.en_text: Please, sit down. We need to talk.
transcript.zh_text: 请坐下。我们需要谈谈。

transcript.en_text: Nothing is going to come from anger right now.
transcript.zh_text: 现在生气解决不了任何问题。

transcript.en_text: Last night when we were talking, you called this house a palace.
transcript.zh_text: 昨晚我们聊天的时候，你说这房子是宫殿。

transcript.en_text: This is where we began.
transcript.zh_text: 这是我们起步的地方。

transcript.en_text: And do you remember when my mother almost left Daddy because he funded your campaign?
transcript.zh_text: 你还记得我母亲差点因为你父亲资助你的竞选而离开他吗？

transcript.en_text: That's how much she hated you.
transcript.zh_text: 她就是那么恨你。

transcript.en_text: But I didn't care, because I saw something. I saw a future.
transcript.zh_text: 但我不在乎，因为我看到了什么。我看到了一个未来。

transcript.en_text: Our future.
transcript.zh_text: 我们的未来。

transcript.en_text: We had a future until you started destroying it.
transcript.zh_text: 我们本来有一个未来，直到你开始破坏它。

transcript.en_text: Well, you wouldn't have listened otherwise.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，否则你不会听的。

transcript.en_text: I always listen to you.
transcript.zh_text: 我总是听你说的。

transcript.en_text: Only when it's what you want to hear.
transcript.zh_text: 只有当你想听的时候。

transcript.en_text: Well, all right, Claire. I'm listening now.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，克莱尔。我现在在听。

transcript.en_text: What is it you so desperately needed to say?
transcript.zh_text: 你这么迫不及待要说的是什么？

transcript.en_text: We've never lost a race in 30 years. We started here and we've always won.
transcript.zh_text: 三十年来我们从未输过一次选举。我们从这里起步，我们一直在赢。

transcript.en_text: You and I, together.
transcript.zh_text: 你和我，一起。

transcript.en_text: But you are losing, Francis.
transcript.zh_text: 但你在输，弗朗西斯。

transcript.en_text: People are getting killed at the gas pumps.
transcript.zh_text: 百姓要在加油站打架了。

transcript.en_text: America Works is falling flat.
transcript.zh_text: 美国工程计划正在失败。

transcript.en_text: Your campaign manager is ten years behind ten years ago.
transcript.zh_text: 你的竞选经理比十年前还落后十年。

transcript.en_text: You don't have a viable running mate.
transcript.zh_text: 你没有一个可行的竞选搭档。

transcript.en_text: We both know it can't be Donald Blythe.
transcript.zh_text: 我们都知道不可能是唐纳德·布莱斯。

transcript.en_text: Well, of course not.
transcript.zh_text: 当然不行。

transcript.en_text: But I have to win the goddamn nomination before I can start worrying about winning.
transcript.zh_text: 但我得先赢得提名，才能开始操心赢得大选。

transcript.en_text: Even if I hadn't done what I did, your race is in real trouble.
transcript.zh_text: 即使我没做那些事，你的选情也确实很危险。

transcript.en_text: You need me, Francis.
transcript.zh_text: 你需要我，弗朗西斯。

transcript.en_text: My approvals are higher than yours.
transcript.zh_text: 我的支持率比你高。

transcript.en_text: I can help you win Texas.
transcript.zh_text: 我能帮你赢得德州。

transcript.en_text: Exactly. Which is why I didn't want you running in Dallas.
transcript.zh_text: 正是因此我不想你在达拉斯参选。

transcript.en_text: I need you at my side.
transcript.zh_text: 我需要你在我身边。

transcript.en_text: Yes, but in a different way.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，但要以不同的方式。

transcript.en_text: Different how?
transcript.zh_text: 什么不同方式？

transcript.en_text: We make each other stronger, can we agree to that?
transcript.zh_text: 我们让彼此更强大，你同意吗？

transcript.en_text: When it's working, but it's not working.
transcript.zh_text: 有效的时候是这样，但现在没有。

transcript.en_text: We can make it work.
transcript.zh_text: 我们可以让它重新有效。

transcript.en_text: We can accomplish that future I saw when we first got married.
transcript.zh_text: 我们可以实现我刚结婚时看到的那个未来。

transcript.en_text: It was us, as partners, real partners.
transcript.zh_text: 那是我们作为搭档，真正的搭档。

transcript.en_text: Let's run together, again.
transcript.zh_text: 让我们再一起参选吧。

transcript.en_text: Not just as husband and wife.
transcript.zh_text: 不只是作为夫妻。

transcript.en_text: You don't mean...
transcript.zh_text: 你不是说……

transcript.en_text: Yes.
transcript.zh_text: 是的。

transcript.en_text: I'm worried about you, Claire.
transcript.zh_text: 我很担心你，克莱尔。

transcript.en_text: You're not making any sense. You've let your ego get in the way-- I've always been your running mate.
transcript.zh_text: 你在胡说八道。你让你的自大蒙蔽了你—— 我一直都是你的竞选搭档。

transcript.en_text: - You just didn't wanna see it. - As my vice president?
transcript.zh_text: ——你只是不想承认。——当我的副总统？

transcript.en_text: - Jesus. Do you have any idea-- - I've put a lot of thought into this.
transcript.zh_text: ——天哪。你知不知道—— ——我深思熟虑过了。

transcript.en_text: You can't have thought it through.
transcript.zh_text: 你不可能想清楚了。

transcript.en_text: - You'd come up with a million reasons-- - She's never run for anything.
transcript.zh_text: ——你会找出一百万个理由—— ——她从来没参加过任何选举。

transcript.en_text: No children, nepotism, arrogance, I've run through them all.
transcript.zh_text: 没有孩子，任人唯亲，傲慢，我全想过了。

transcript.en_text: You can't win without me.
transcript.zh_text: 没有我你赢不了。

transcript.en_text: I would rather have a spineless Donald Blythe as my vice president than a woman who's never held elected office.
transcript.zh_text: 我宁愿让一个懦弱的唐纳德·布莱斯当我的副总统，也不选一个从来没当过选公职的女人。

transcript.en_text: You're losing to a woman who's never held elected office.
transcript.zh_text: 你正在输给一个从来没有竞选过公职的女人。

transcript.en_text: You don't deserve it.
transcript.zh_text: 你不配。

transcript.en_text: You have no idea what it means to have nothing.
transcript.zh_text: 你不知道一无所有是什么滋味。

transcript.en_text: You don't value what we have achieved.
transcript.zh_text: 你不珍惜我们取得的成就。

transcript.en_text: I have had to fight for everything my entire life.
transcript.zh_text: 我一辈子都在为一切而奋斗。

transcript.en_text: Do you know why I kept this?
transcript.zh_text: 你知道我为什么留着这个吗？

transcript.en_text: Do you know?
transcript.zh_text: 你知道吗？

transcript.en_text: Because it's the one time I was proud of my father.
transcript.zh_text: 因为这是我唯一一次为我父亲感到骄傲。

transcript.en_text: Because this man, in this moment, as despicable as it was, is fighting to survive.
transcript.zh_text: 因为这个人，在那个时刻，尽管那很可鄙，他在为生存而挣扎。

transcript.en_text: He is doing whatever it took.
transcript.zh_text: 他不惜一切代价。

transcript.en_text: And so will I, with or without you.
transcript.zh_text: 我也会这样做，不管有没有你。

transcript.en_text: So no, I will not have this conversation. I will not indulge you any further.
transcript.zh_text: 所以不，我不会进行这个谈话。我不会再纵容你了。

transcript.en_text: You have to let this go.
transcript.zh_text: 你必须放下这件事。

transcript.en_text: I can be a part of your campaign, or I can end it.
transcript.zh_text: 我可以成为你竞选的一部分，或者我可以结束它。

transcript.en_text: I'll do whatever it takes, too. Just like your father.
transcript.zh_text: 我也会不惜一切代价。就像你的父亲一样。

transcript.en_text: But I will not let this go.
transcript.zh_text: 但我不会放弃。

transcript.en_text: I'll need a car to the Greenville Airport.
transcript.zh_text: 我需要一辆车去格林维尔机场。

transcript.en_text: To Dallas, yes.
transcript.zh_text: 去达拉斯，是的。
